title: Veggie Black Bean Enchiladas
style: Hearty vegetarian enchiladas loaded with vegetables, black beans, and homemade red sauce.
description: Vegetarian enchiladas stuffed with black beans, broccoli, bell pepper, and spinach, topped with a rich homemade red sauce.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C). Lightly grease a 9×13-inch baking dish.

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion with a pinch of salt for 5–7 minutes until translucent. Add broccoli and bell pepper, cover, and cook 8–9 minutes until tender and lightly golden.
Add cumin and cinnamon; cook 30 seconds until fragrant. Add spinach in batches, stirring until wilted.
Transfer mixture to a bowl. Stir in black beans, 1/4 cup cheese, and about 2 tablespoons enchilada sauce. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread 1/4 cup enchilada sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Fill each tortilla with about 1/2 cup filling, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in the dish.
Pour remaining sauce over enchiladas, leaving ends exposed. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes. Move to upper rack for 3–6 minutes if needed until golden and bubbly. Rest 10 minutes before serving. Garnish with cilantro.
tips: Make it vegan by skipping the cheese or using a dairy-free alternative.
Warm tortillas before rolling to prevent cracking, especially corn tortillas.
Leftovers keep well refrigerated for up to 4 days.
